_comment: Produced by `npm run discover:betano` or `npm run discover:har` (spec §5.2.2). Copy to betano.json and fill in. Betano.ng runs on Kaizen Gaming's platform: responses are a NORMALIZED STORE of three flat ID-keyed maps (events, markets, selections) joined by marketIdList/selectionIdList, with the handicap on the SELECTION. The adapter detects and joins this automatically.

_confirmed_20260721.storeShape: { events, markets, selections } — flat maps, joined by ID
_confirmed_20260721.handicapLocation: on the selection, e.g. { name: 'Over 18.5', handicap: 18.5, price: 1.9 }

gameLevelMarketCodes.FTPO: 157 — Total Points (game total, NOT a player prop)

_confirmed_20260721.coverageWarning: The coupon/list response hydrates only ~3 headline markets per event even when totalMarketsAvailable is 200+. Player props require the per-event request fired when the event page's Players tab opens.
_confirmed_20260721.note: Esports basketball also reports sportId BASK — team names carry a handle in brackets, e.g. 'Denver Nuggets (TAAPZ)'. Filter these out by league, or by rejecting names matching /\([A-Z0-9]+\)$/.

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

_marketMapNote: Matched against market.name. Once the player-prop TYPE CODES are known from `--census`, prefer matching on those: codes are stable across locales, display names are not.
_marketTypeMapNote: Preferred once known: exact Kaizen type codes from the census, e.g. { "PLPT": "POINTS" }. Leave empty until confirmed.
